tradition: South Indian Jyotish (Tamil, Kannada, Andhra, Kerala)
primary_source: Kalaprakashika, Chapter 11 (Ashtakoota & Dasa Koota); Muhurtha Ratna; Muhurtha Padavi

dina.name: Dina Porutham
dina.rule: Count from bride's star to groom's star, divide by 9. Remainder 2, 4, 6, 8, 0 pass; remainder 1, 3, 5, 7 fail. Standard rule strictly applied.

gana.name: Gana Porutham
gana.rule: Same Gana (Deva-Deva, Manushya-Manushya, Rakshasa-Rakshasa) or Deva Groom with Manushya Bride passes (Pass). Manushya Groom with Deva Bride is conditionally acceptable (Conditional). Any pairing involving Rakshasa with Deva or Manushya fails (Fail).

mahendra.name: Mahendra Porutham
mahendra.dimension: Lineage, Family Growth, Progeny, and Wealth
mahendra.rule: Count from Bride star to Groom star must be one of: 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25 (Pass); all other counts fail.

stree_deergha.name: Stree Deergha Porutham
stree_deergha.dimension: Longevity, Comfort, and Wellbeing of the Wife
stree_deergha.rule: Count from Bride star to Groom star: > 13 Pass (Uthama); 8 to 13 Conditional (Madhyama); <= 7 Fail (Adhama).

yoni.name: Yoni Porutham
yoni.rule: The birth stars' animal pairs are scored in the Yoni table used here (unverified; traditions differ). Enemy (Maha Vaira) pair does not pass (Fail). Same animal passes (Pass). Neutral animal is conditional (Conditional).

rasi.name: Rasi Porutham
rasi.dimension: Domestic Harmony, Lineage Continuity, and Unity
rasi.rule: Moon sign distance from Bride to Groom should be 7 (Samasaptaka), 3, 4, 10, or 11 (Pass). Dispositions 6/8 (Shadashtaka) and 2/12 (Dwirdwadasha) fail (Fail) unless cancelled by same or friendly lord.

rasyadhipathi.name: Rasyadhipathi Porutham
rasyadhipathi.dimension: Mental Friendship between Moon Sign Rulers
rasyadhipathi.rule: Planetary rulers of Groom and Bride Moon signs must be natural mutual friends or identical (Pass). Friendly-neutral or neutral-neutral is conditional (Conditional). Inimical rulers fail (Fail).

vashya.name: Vashya Porutham
vashya.rule: One sign must naturally exert classical Vashya over the other sign (Pass). Mutual Vashya is highest. Total absence of Vashya relationship fails (Fail).

rajju.name: Rajju Porutham
rajju.rule: Birth stars must not belong to the same Rajju (Shiro, Kantha, Udara, Kati, Pada). Same Rajju does not pass (Fail). Different Rajjus pass (Pass). (unverified; traditions differ)

vedha.name: Vedha Porutham
vedha.rule: Birth stars must not form the Vedha pairs used here (Star Repulsion). Vedha presence fails the porutham (Fail). Absence of Vedha passes (Pass). (unverified; traditions differ)
